sub_branches.why_included: Smooth muscle-like nodules with low cellularity, no cytological atypia and few mitoses

sub_branches.label: Aggressive angiomyxoma
sub_branches.why_included: Complex mass originating from the right pelvis, extending to the right hypochondrium and epigastrium, with a transverse extension of over 20 cm
